text:
On macOS, find the process using port 8080:

```bash
lsof -i :8080
```

Or use:

```bash
sudo lsof -i :8080
```

Find the PID in the output, then kill it:

```bash
sudo kill -9 <PID>
```

Example:
```bash
$ sudo lsof -i :8080
COMMAND   PID   USER   FD   TYPE DEVICE SIZE/OFF NODE NAME
node    12345  alice   12u  IPv4  12345      0t0  TCP *:8080 (LISTEN)

$ sudo kill -9 12345
```

Verify port is free:

```bash
lsof -i :8080
```

No output means the port is free. Then retry `docker compose up -d`.
